audio.selection: Last audio-devicetree commit before the 2022-03-14 LA.VENDOR 11900 release; contains the CAPE and WAIPIO audio DT.

video.selection: Only public WAIPIO video DT in the legacy qcom,msm-vidc binding read by video-driver 8608fb2; its waipio-vidc.dts already lists the CAPE msm-ids 530/531/540.

mmrm.source: stock OS3.0.8.0.VMNCNXM: CAPE DTB of vendor_boot + mondrian entry of dtbo
mmrm.reason: Previously unselected because public Qualcomm WAIPIO MMRM DTs have six or eight voltage corners and no CAPE coefficients while mmrm-driver 69e304b reads exactly five. The stock OS3 CAPE node has exactly five voltage corners (lowsvs, svs, svsl1, nom, turbo), CAPE scaling factors and 28 five-cell clock-source entries, the format this driver parses; every clock id resolves to a *_CLK_SRC of our kernel headers. Without the node msm-mmrm.ko does not probe.
